scenes.title: Lighting and fine detail with few samples
lines: If we cannot calculate every light path, which samples should we choose? We will connect Cyberpunk's path tracing and reconstruction, Unreal's many lights, and thin hair and overlapping surfaces. Comparing actual screen changes with worked examples, we begin with how one path contributes to brightness.
